notes.title: Twisted Waters Devlog #2 | How I accidentally made 1 million houses
notes.content:
A new devlog about Twisted Waters is out and it is certainly an interesting one! I wanted to add houses to make the open world feel lived in. Not just any houses, but nice ones so they could look good in the game. But somehow along the way, I ended up with a million of them! 

Watch the new devlog to find out how it happened and if the houses actually looked good at the end.

[previewyoutube=yy5KhYoSJ1k;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Page Update & Devlogs
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

It’s been a while since Twisted Waters Steam page was up and it was in need of a refresh. The game is still in active development so the page is also a work-in-progress. There will be more updates about all the cool things in the game. But for now, please enjoy the new art and more screenshots to see what the game looks like right now.

Also, a second devlog is on its way so this would be a great moment to refresh your memory of how Twisted Waters used to look when it was announced in the first devlog.

[previewyoutube=dSXezvBUMo0;full][/previewyoutube]
